name: Exp_Volume_Weighted_MA
summary: This EA trades based on the Volume Weighted Moving Average indicator, generating buy signals when the VWMA turns upward and sell signals when it turns downward. It compares three consecutive VWMA values to detect trend direction changes and uses configurable money management modes for position sizing. Entries and exits are controlled separately with boolean toggles, and StopLoss/TakeProfit levels are applied to all positions.
summary_zh: 该EA基于成交量加权移动平均线(VWMA)指标进行交易，当VWMA拐头向上时产生买入信号，拐头向下时产生卖出信号。通过比较三个连续的VWMA值来检测趋势方向变化，并使用可配置的资金管理模式进行仓位管理。入场和出场分别通过布尔开关独立控制，所有仓位均设置止损和止盈。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于成交量加权移动平均线(VWMA)的趋势跟踪，利用成交量对价格的加权来确认趋势的真实性。入场条件为：当Value[1]<Value[2]（VWMA从下降转为上升）且Value[0]>Value[1]（当前值继续上升）时开多单；当Value[1]>Value[2]（VWMA从上升转为下降）且Value[0]<Value[1]时开空单。出场条件为：趋势反转时分别平仓——VWMA下降时平多单，VWMA上升时平空单，同时设置固定点数的止损(1000点)和止盈(2000点)。仓位管理支持多种模式，包括按可用保证金比例、按余额比例、按扣除浮亏后的保证金/余额比例，以及固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例（默认0.1），配合MMMode选择具体的计算方式。策略使用了新K线检测机制（IsNewBar），避免在同一根K线内重复开仓，同时也支持在SignalBar为0时每个tick都进行信号计算。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is trend following based on the Volume Weighted Moving Average (VWMA), which uses volume weighting to confirm the authenticity of price trends. Entry conditions: a buy signal is generated when Value[1]<Value[2] (VWMA turns from declining to rising) and Value[0]>Value[1] (current value continues rising); a sell signal is generated when Value[1]>Value[2] (VWMA turns from rising to declining) and Value[0]<Value[1]. Exit conditions: positions are closed on trend reversal — long positions close when VWMA declines, short positions close when VWMA rises, with fixed StopLoss (1000 points) and TakeProfit (2000 points) applied. Position sizing supports multiple modes including percentage of free margin, percentage of balance, percentage of margin/balance minus floating loss, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled by the MM parameter (default 0.1 risk ratio) combined with the MMMode selector for the specific calculation method. The strategy employs a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to prevent repeated entries within the same bar, while also supporting per-tick signal calculation when SignalBar is set to 0.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description_en: Money management ratio or lot value

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（保证金/余额/固定手数等）
parameters.description_en: Lot mode: free margin/balance/post-loss free margin/post-loss balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: IPC
parameters.description_en: Price type applied to indicator calculation

parameters.name: VolumeType
parameters.description_en: Volume type: tick volume or real volume

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description_en: Indicator offset relative to current bar

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description_en: Bar index for signal reading (0=current, 1=last completed)

pros: 使用成交量加权移动平均线，相比简单移动平均更能反映真实的市场趋势强度
入场和出场逻辑完全独立可控，灵活性高，可以只开仓不平仓或只平仓不开仓
具备新K线检测机制，防止同一根K线内重复开仓，减少过度交易风险
支持多种资金管理模式，适应不同风险偏好的交易者
pros_en: Uses volume-weighted moving average which better reflects true market trend strength compared to simple moving averages
Entry and exit logic is independently controllable, offering high flexibility to enable only opening or only closing
Implements new bar detection mechanism to prevent repeated entries within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Supports multiple money management modes, accommodating traders with different risk preferences
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点作为固定值，未根据市场波动率（ATR）动态调整，在不同市场环境下可能不适用
缺乏对现有持仓的检查，可能在同方向已有持仓时重复开仓导致仓位叠加
未考虑点差和手续费对交易成本的影响，在点差较大的品种上可能影响盈利
信号逻辑仅依赖三个VWMA值的简单比较，缺乏过滤条件如趋势强度确认或震荡市场识别
cons_en: Fixed StopLoss of 1000 points and TakeProfit of 2000 points are not dynamically adjusted based on market volatility (ATR), making them unsuitable for varying market conditions
Lacks checking for existing positions, which may lead to duplicate entries in the same direction causing position stacking
Does not account for spread and commission costs, which could impact profitability on high-spread instruments
Signal logic relies solely on simple comparison of three VWMA values, lacking filters such as trend strength confirmation or range market identification
improvements: 引入ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动率自动调整止损止盈距离，提高策略适应性
增加持仓检查逻辑，避免同方向重复开仓，可加入最大持仓数限制
增加趋势过滤指标（如ADX或更高周期均线方向），在震荡行情中减少虚假信号
improvements_en: Introduce ATR-based dynamic StopLoss/TakeProfit to automatically adjust distance based on market volatility, improving strategy adaptability
Add position checking logic to avoid duplicate entries in the same direction, with a maximum position count limit
Add a trend filter indicator (such as ADX or higher timeframe MA direction) to reduce false signals in ranging markets

risk_points: 缺乏持仓检查，可能在同方向重复开仓导致风险敞口过大
固定止损止盈不适应不同波动率环境，低波动时止损过大，高波动时止损过小
VWMA在震荡市场中会产生频繁虚假信号，导致连续亏损
risk_points_en: Lacks position checking, which may lead to excessive risk exposure from duplicate entries in the same direction
Fixed StopLoss/TakeProfit does not adapt to different volatility environments — too wide in low volatility, too tight in high volatility
VWMA generates frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses

Entries and exits are controlled separately with boolean toggles, and StopLoss/TakeProfit levels are applied to all positions.
